messages:
Raven (People Ops): Installing a short "pop-up" reviewer coverage process for the final 72h of the cycle. Purpose: cover LOA, timezone gaps, and sudden reviewer attrition. Sign-up sheet: https://docs.google.com/shortlink.

Diego: If I pick up a slot, do I need to edit the form or just add a comment?

Raven (People Ops): Add a single-line comment in the review form: 'COVER: from @Original to @You; reason: coverage'. Then paste the handoff checklist here. Do not change scores.

Samir: Handback checklist?

Raven (People Ops): Paste this when transfering: - confirm comments saved - set reviewer field - note any pending evidence - tag "coverage" for sampling - DM original reviewer the transfer confirmation

Lina: What about calibration sample fairness? We have multiple reassigned reviews in one team.

Raven (People Ops): Reassigned items are flagged and included in the next calibration batch for that manager. If reassigned >20% of a manager's workload, run a mini-calibration with Ops.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: coverage sign-ups close in 48 hours.

Diego: Got it. I'll sign up for the EU morning slot and mark the items handled.

Raven (People Ops): Thanks! Ping me if any edgecases (contractor reviewers, holidays)—we'll route approvals through #people-ops-escalations.
